prompt:
The snippet snippets/blog-comment-labels.liquid renders the label block for an article's comment form. Theme Check reports errors in it because several literal operands point at assets, translation keys and snippets that do not exist in this theme. Read the theme files that are provided (assets/, locales/en.default.json, locales/fr.json, snippets/) and fix every broken reference so that each one points to the existing file or key that serves the same purpose.

There are 7 references to fix:
1. The stylesheet loaded with asset_url | stylesheet_tag must be the theme's blog comments CSS asset.
2. The script src loaded with asset_url must be the theme's blog comments JavaScript asset.
3. Both render tags (the person icon and the mail icon) must render the theme's comment icon snippet. Keep the icon: 'person' and icon: 'mail' arguments exactly as they are.
4. The four t filter keys must be the comment form keys for the name label, email label, message label and 'replying to' text. The 'replying to' translation interpolates author, so keep the author: author argument.

Constraints: change only the literal strings listed above. Keep all markup, element order, attributes, the assign that trims the comment author with strip, the author != blank condition, and every whitespace-control dash ({%- -%} and {{- -}}) byte-for-byte as they are. Do not delete any reference to make an error go away, and do not create or edit any files other than the snippet. When finished, Theme Check must report no MissingAsset, TranslationKeyExists or MissingTemplate errors for the snippet. Change only snippets/blog-comment-labels.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
